title: Pricing and What Is Included | R&SVP – Hio Ridge, Bridgton, Maine
description: What a wedding at Hio Ridge includes: the barn and loft for 135, bridal and groom rooms, prep kitchen, patio and ceremony field. Ask for the pricing brochure.
heading: Pricing
lede: One barn, one couple, one Sunday. Everything below is included. For the current rates, ask for the pricing brochure and we will send it the same day.
price_note: Sunday weddings, May through October. Weekday events are priced separately. [CONFIRM: weekday and event rates]
included: The barn, main floor and loft, for up to 135 guests
The bridal room and the groom's room in the ell
The ceremony field facing Pleasant Mountain, with benches
The patio with string lights and the stone seating circle
6-foot and 8-foot tables, 5-foot rounds, and chairs for the ceremony and the reception
The prep kitchen for your caterer
Parking for 66 cars and three accessible spaces
An ADA accessible bathroom and a ramp to the main floor
Susan and Richard on site for the day
[CONFIRM: setup and breakdown, hours of access, rehearsal time]
compare: Barn venues within forty minutes of Bridgton list from about $8,000 to $13,000 for the day, and most of that buys a bar. We are an alcohol-free venue, so there is no bar to build, insure or staff. That is where the difference goes. [CONFIRM: Susan is comfortable with this comparison]
events: Showers, reunions, retreats, teas, workshops and small concerts are priced by the day or the afternoon. Tell us the date and the size and we will send the rate. [CONFIRM: event rates]

closing.heading: Ask for the pricing brochure
closing.body: Email or text Susan and she will send the brochure and the open 2027 dates.
